country_fields.timezone_note: Wikivoyage Broken Hill: "Broken Hill and Silverton operate on ACST; all other towns in the region operate on AEST". IANA Australia/Broken_Hill covers Broken Hill and Silverton (Yancowinna County), so every Broken Hill proposed-destination place uses Australia/Broken_Hill; everything else in the region uses Australia/Sydney. Cameron Corner, Tibooburra and Menindee are in the Sydney zone by law (locals sometimes keep Central time); verify in research.

proposed_destination_note: All kept places lie far outside the existing AU destinations (sydney, blue-mountains, warrumbungle); none is a spot of an existing destination. Eleven destinations are PROPOSED for the owner and not added: broken-hill (8 spots), lightning-ridge (4), cobar (2), brewarrina (2), kinchega-national-park (2), mungo-national-park (1), mutawintji-national-park (1), and four parks with no kept spots (sturt, gundabooka, paroo-darling, toorale). Parks with no kept spot are thin destinations: if the owner declines them, each becomes a standalone park spot via its if_declined block (after a visitor-point pin is found). Standalone as placed: Bourke, White Cliffs, Cameron Corner Survey Marker. Every proposed destination also lists each of its places under if_declined as the standalone spot it becomes.
sturt_note: Cameron Corner is placed standalone rather than under proposed sturt-national-park: it is about 97 km from the park centre and 140 km by road from Tibooburra, so the destination span would balloon past 130 km. If the owner prefers it under Sturt, widen defaultZoomSpanKm to about 130. The Dingo Fence is named in its bio, not a spot (skeptic reject).
